title: Pilgrims and Patriots Quiz
description: Test your knowledge about the Pilgrims, Patriots, and America's early days!

questions.question: Why did the Pilgrims leave England?
questions.explanation: The Pilgrims left England because they wanted to worship God freely without the king telling them how to worship.

questions.question: What was the name of the Pilgrims' ship?
questions.explanation: The Pilgrims sailed to America on a ship called the Mayflower in 1620.

questions.question: Who helped the Pilgrims learn to plant corn and catch fish?
questions.explanation: Squanto, a Native American, helped the Pilgrims learn to plant corn, catch fish, and survive in their new land.

questions.question: Why did the Pilgrims celebrate the first Thanksgiving?
options: To thank God for His blessings
questions.explanation: The Pilgrims celebrated the first Thanksgiving to thank God for keeping them alive and giving them a good harvest.

questions.question: What did colonial children use to learn to read?
options: The Bible and the New England Primer
questions.explanation: Colonial children learned to read using the Bible and a book called the New England Primer, which taught letters with Bible verses.

questions.question: What did Paul Revere do on his famous midnight ride?
options: Warned colonists that British soldiers were coming
questions.explanation: Paul Revere rode through the countryside at night to warn the colonists that British soldiers were marching toward them.

questions.question: Who wrote the Declaration of Independence?
questions.explanation: Thomas Jefferson wrote the Declaration of Independence, which said all people are created equal and have God-given rights.

questions.question: When did America declare its independence?
questions.explanation: America declared its independence on July 4, 1776. That is why we celebrate the Fourth of July every year!
